rationale: Charter: optionality that reflects real variation among instances (a view may be routable or not) is working as designed. The boolean is correct; the old one-line description was loose and the proposed definition ('either the target of a navigation route or opened as a standalone surface') already resolves it.

rationale: Charter: attribute names must not collide with a differently-typed attribute of the same name on sibling types; such collisions caused silent data loss (0.1.11). Verified: accesscondition.source is a required string with no description, nine security siblings declare source as an optional 'Source code reference' object. Breaking fix (rename or retype).
adjudicated_by: claude, re-adjudicated against spec/DESIGN_CHARTER.md (adopted 2026-10-25); user approved the process

rationale: Charter: composes runs whole -> part. A rule composes its conditions; accesscondition composes policyrule makes the condition the whole. Verified both files exist (accesscondition composes policyrule; policyrule uses accesscondition). Modellers following CLI suggestions record it backwards; breaking to remove.
adjudicated_by: claude, re-adjudicated against spec/DESIGN_CHARTER.md (adopted 2026-10-25); user approved the process

rationale: Charter: a defect includes declaring one concept in two places without a boundary, and a definition should let a reader decide membership. The dataobject definition names only in-layer siblings and says nothing about data-model.objectschema or data-store entities, which is the confusion that matters (Phase 0: application -> data-model was the top cross-layer confusion on dr-cli). Wording fix: a precedence rule.

rationale: Charter: declaring one concept in two places is a defect. namespace's description lists 'Elasticsearch index' as a namespace mapping while collection.collectionType has SEARCH_INDEX. Wording fix: remove it from namespace (an index holds documents; it is a collection).

rationale: Charter: direction is defined by the predicate, never by the layers, and realizes runs from the realizing element to what it realizes. An API operation does not realize an application function; the function realizes (implements) the operation. The relationship exists in this orientation only because of the old layer-number rule. Fix: replace with application.applicationfunction realizes api.operation (or api.operation served-by ...), a breaking change for models that recorded it.
adjudicated_by: claude, re-adjudicated against spec/DESIGN_CHARTER.md (adopted 2026-10-25); user approved the process
